message.content: This editorial illustration depicts a confrontation between four figures in suits and a lone man in casual attire. On the left, four people—three men and one woman—stand in a line. The man at the far left wears a dark suit and a black peci. The woman next to him wears a brown suit and high heels. Two more men in grey and dark blue suits follow, all leaning forward with furrowed brows and clenched fists. Facing them on the right is a man wearing a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt with rolled sleeves and grey trousers. He holds a large hoe with a wooden handle and a grey metal blade across his body. The figures stand on a light-green grassy surface dotted with small black spots. In the background, a large building with a tiered, arched roof structure sits under a yellow sky with stylized white clouds. The top of the image contains the red "TEMPO" logo and text including "GEGERAN PANGAN," "Bersaing Memburu Riza Chalid," "Terjepit Utang Kereta Cepat," and "DPR dan Ombudsman menemukan beras rusak di gudang Bulog."
